mentions.name: vibeworld
mentions.description: A terminal-based cyberpunk multiplayer shared persistent world accessed by typing "vibeworld" in the terminal. It features themed continents (physics, computer science, etc.) with cyberpunk cities where users can create, expand, and enter chatroom "corners" with text and voice chat, create avatars and optionally share their GitHub, and visit a moon with a pixelated starry sky, a communal plant that dies unless someone waters it, chill low-quality music, and a spot to "scream" about LLM sessions visible to everyone from space. Meant to be left open on a second monitor while working, letting developers and scientists casually meet and chat while working late. Runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
mentions.audience: The idea is that developers and scientists can meet each other in the terminal in a funny way at 3 am while working.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a cyberpunk multiplayer, shared, persistent world which runs completely in a terminal, and you can access just by typing "vibeworld" in the terminal(https://github.com/SorBalda/vibeworld).
mentions.author: sorbalda
